summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its monthly net asset value determination and updated offering prices. The board set NAV per share as of June 30, 2026 at $25.34 (Class E) and $24.99 (Class FA), with total NAV of $27.5 billion. New offering prices were established for unsold share classes (A, T, I). The filing also disclosed $9.2 million in preferred equity for MSR interests and $65.3 million in residential mortgage whole loan purchases. This routine periodic update does not constitute a special situation event; it's a standard REIT reporting requirement.
